latestReleaseNotes:
### Release info
Oobee is available as a desktop app for Mac and Windows. The setup files can be downloaded under `Assets` at the bottom of the page.

### Installation Guide
* Refer to the [Installation Guide](https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/blob/master/INSTALLATION.md) for Windows and Mac.

### What's New
This release ensures pages can no longer silently vanish from a scan: pages that hit a transient failure are now retried, and pages that are skipped (robots.txt-blocked, off-site redirects, unsupported content) are listed as unscanned in the JSON, CSV and report. It also makes the desktop app trust the operating system's certificate store, which fixes connections on networks that use a corporate/custom root CA, and quiets a failing GenAI feature-flag fetch in the report.

#### Fixes
* fix: report every dropped page as unscanned instead of losing it by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/903
* fix: quiet GenAI feature flag fetch failure in report and add timeout by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/902
* fix(tls): trust the OS certificate store in the main process by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/305

#### Version bumps
* chore: bump version to v0.11.21 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/306

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/compare/0.11.20...0.11.21
